owner_decision.source: Owner 9 Nov 2026 supplied the page-by-page proofread reading of all 74 scans (desk-9632-74of74-FULL-PROOFREAD.json), asked for release and stated that the document holds two Acts: the Karachi Improvement Trust Act, 1950 (Act XLVIII of 1950, scans 1-74) and, on the last scan after the closing section 11 of the Schedule, a separate Act XLIX of 1950 amending the Karachi Secondary Education Act, 1950. Delegated decision (recommended option, owner policy q1 'split'): one expression per Act.

expressions.title: The Karachi Improvement Trust Act, 1950
expressions.title_basis: p1 prints 'ACT No. XLVIII OF 1950' and its long title; sections 1-? and the Schedule (amendments of the Land Acquisition Act) follow to the closing paragraph 11 on p74 (block 2584561).
expressions.expected_tree: preamble, sections of the Karachi Improvement Trust Act and its Schedule

expressions.title: The Karachi Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 1950
expressions.title_basis: p74 prints, below the Schedule's closing paragraph 11 and a printer's rule, 'ACT No. XLIX OF 1950.', 'An Act to amend the Karachi Secondary Education Act, 1950.', a preamble, section 1 ('This Act may be called the Karachi Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 1950.') and section 2, signed M. B. Ahmed, Secretary.
